metadata.title: HDBLAST: homogeneous metric-response calibration on prescribed de Sitter geometry
metadata.description: Reproducible separately registered comparison of quantum variance, direct minimal density and pressure, and scalar current under homogeneous metric pulses at H=1 and fixed x=r=2. Includes complete metric operator/subtraction contacts, exact gauge/general-root prerequisites, raw mode archives, empirical numerical checks, and conservative omitted-UV-band bounds. Internal AI-assisted cross-checks are not external peer review. The special-point benchmark does not establish actual-root response, coupled evolution, stability, heat or a Big Bang mechanism. Reports/data CC BY 4.0; source code MIT. Prepared metadata is not a published deposit or DOI.
